notes.not_a_quality_fix: Configuration chosen from 60-patient diagnostics; quality on the full train set is to be measured.
notes.test: 186 test patients remain closed: metadata only (counts/labels/split); no PNG opened, no features, no predictions; no test CLI.
notes.validation_reuse: 20 pilot-validation patients (Stage 28 pilot_manifest) were used during Stage 29/30 tuning; validation is for model selection, NOT an independent final estimate.

run_matrix.launch: each run explicitly by --budget/--seed; never automatically

settings.amp_skip_policy: after 3 consecutive skipped steps: save state, stop with status AMP_SKIPS, no auto-resume
settings.architecture: torchvision ResNet18 (fc=Identity) + gated attention (V/U 512->128, w 128->1) + Linear(512,2)
settings.augmentation: Stage 29 augmentation_code(pid, epoch, tile, seed): D4, identical across K for shared patches
settings.diagnostics_frequency: once per epoch (and epoch 0 for the train-eval subset); identical for all K
settings.head_init: original (Stage 29 build_model with the run seed); not zero
settings.partial_last_group: kept; loss divided by actual number of patients in the group; no drop, no duplication
settings.patch_selection: Stage 29 patch_indices(pid, epoch, K, seed): nested K16 c K32 c K64
settings.patient_order: Stage 29 patient_order(ids, epoch, seed) ('original'); identical across K for a seed
settings.step_update_norms: not computed in main runs (no per-step parameter copies); epoch-level weight change only
settings.train_eval_subset: 10 LUAD + 10 LUSC train patients, first by SHA256('stage31-train-eval-v1|'+ID) within class
settings.weights: official ImageNet ResNet18 resnet18-f37072fd.pth prepared and verified by Stage 29

smoke_subsets.compat_pilot80: pilot train 60 / pilot validation 20 (Stage 28 pilot_manifest), train-eval 10+10 from these 60
smoke_subsets.resume_19: pilot train first 7 LUAD + 6 LUSC by pilot_order_within_class (13 -> groups 4,4,4,1); pilot validation first 3 + 3; train-eval 3+3

stopping.criterion: mean patient-level validation cross-entropy over all validation patients (186)
stopping.selected_model: checkpoint with minimal validation CE (best_model.pt; authoritative copy = best checkpoint generation)
stopping.tie_rule: equal CE keeps the earlier best checkpoint
